title: NA JAANE KIS TARAH LAILA NE DEKHA JAWAA'N BETA HAI AUR ZAKHMI KALEJA
body:
Khudaya kaise Sarwar ne Uthaya
ZaeefimeJawa'n Bete ka Laasha
Rakha khaime meLakar jab janaza
WoLaasha sar se pa tak khoo'n bhara tha
<<MINI>>
Na jaane kis tarahLaila ne Dekha
Jawaa'n Beta hai aur zakhmi kaleja
<<DIVIDER>>
MadinemeWo aksar sonchti thi
Bahu hogi Hamari chaand jaisi
Bada armaan tha shaadi ka jiski
Wohi ab saamne bejaa'n pada tha
<<MINI>>
Na jaane kis tarahLaila ne Dekha
Jawaa'n Beta hai aur zakhmi kaleja
<<DIVIDER>>
Basarat ja chuki Sibte Nabi ki
Hui hai khatm ronagq zindagi ki
Luti duniya Hussain Ibne Ali ki
Simat aaya hai aankhon me andhera
<<MINI>>
Na jaane kis tarahLaila ne Dekha
Jawaa'n Beta hai aur zakhmi kaleja
<<DIVIDER>>
Bada zaalim hua tha ye zamana
Kayi hathyaar the aur ek nashana
Jawaani me wo phal barchhi ka khaana
Shabeeh e Mustufa par zulm aisa
<<MINI>>
Na jaane kis tarahLaila ne Dekha
Jawaa'n Beta hai aur zakhmi kaleja
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Jiska Husn tha Husne Payambar
Tha Uspar ye sitam Allah O Akbar
Watan me muntazir thi jis ki Knwahar
Wohi ab khoon meDooba Pada tha
<<MINI>>
Na jaane kis tarahLaila ne Dekha
Jawaa'n Beta hai aur zakhmi kaleja
<<DIVIDER>>
Kamaale sabr ka ye Mojiza tha
Ke khud ko kaise Zainab ne Sambhala
Jise atthaara barso'n tak tha Paala
Usi ke Qalb me toota tha naiza
<<MINI>>
Na jaane kis tarahLaila ne dekha
Jawaa'n Beta hai aur zakhmi kaleja
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi poochhe Ali Akbar ki Maa se
Guzarti kya hai marge Naojawa'n se
Sada aati hai Ahsanaasma'n se
Rahegi umr bhar sakte meDukhiya
<<MINI>>
Na jaane kis tarahLaila ne dekha
Jawaa'n Beta hai aur zakhmi kaleja
